summary: GLM-5.3-Flash loads checkpoints with mixed-format KDA projections and can run its MXFP8 KDA projections with BF16 activations
compatibility: No user action required. VLLM_GLM53_KDA_MXFP8_ACTIVATION_MODE defaults to auto, which keeps the previous behavior.
details: Checkpoints that store KDA q/k/v in MXFP8 or block FP8 and b_proj/f_a_proj in BF16 now load; KDA then runs q|k|v and b|f_a as two GEMMs. Uniform checkpoints keep the fused projection. Block-FP8 kv_b is dequantized directly from its scales.
VLLM_GLM53_KDA_MXFP8_ACTIVATION_MODE=a16 runs the MXFP8 KDA projections with BF16 activations for every call; prefill does so for calls of at least 128 rows and keeps W8A8 for shorter calls.

With the official BF16 KDA gates, indexer and kv_b and W8A16 KDA q/k/v/o, a 516K-token long-context lookup test reaches 79.6% vs 76.5% with W8A8. The FlashInfer B12X A16 MXFP8 fix keeps the extra prefill cost near 1%.
